name: Buzsák (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow pale blue horizontal stripe along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Buzsák: a white shield with a heart, supported by two figures in folk costume, with red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Buzsák arms with supporters and mantling
